name: Yumeura Kasumi
source:
The main character, Haruki, is in love with this girl. She is an unpretentious girl like a flower blooming in the field, and is scheduled to study at Haruki's house on Sunday. 

She is cheerful and kind, and her simple personality is evident. She has no romantic interest in Haruki.

[From [url=https://nijikaku2007.wixsite.com/kinosei]official website[/url]]
